summary: Phase B — Buttons & UI polish verification on /game/1-1 (390x844 viewport). All 7 feature flows passed with no issues found. Pause overlay (RESUME full-width primary + RETRY/LEVELS row), Dead overlay (TIME COLLAPSED, no btn-watch-ad on web as expected, no btn-next), Won overlay (ESCAPED, S grade, 3 stars, NEXT LEVEL + RETRY/LEVELS), double-tap guard (second rapid click within 80ms correctly ignored → navigated 1-1 → 1-2 only), hint auto-fade (visible at t=0, unmounted by t≈5s), press feedback (JUMP + pause scale to matrix(0.94,0,0,0.94,0,0) on press), and regressions (HUD timer counting + turning red at low time, ECHO 0/0 pill, controls working, player feet on ground). Pause card measured 342×208 px at x=24 on a 390 px screen — no clipping. Only minor non-blocking console warnings observed (textShadow* style prop deprecation and pointerEvents prop deprecation from react-native-web) — these are RN-web internal warnings, not from this phase's code.
critical_code_review_comments: SciFiButton.tsx: tapGuardMs (450) stored in a useRef (lastFireRef) is correct — survives re-renders. Clean implementation.
game/[id].tsx: PauseOverlay + OutcomeOverlay card uses width:100% + maxWidth:420 — scales well on 390 px viewport (measured 342×208 with 24 px gutter). No clipping observed.
game/[id].tsx: HintOverlay interval-based opacity fade works but uses setInterval + setState tick (30ms). Would be cheaper via Reanimated withTiming; not a blocker.
game/[id].tsx: areAdsReady() check correctly hides btn-watch-ad on web preview (verified: button never rendered on dead overlay).
controls.tsx + hud.tsx: pressed state transforms (scale 0.94) verified via computed-style check — before=none, during=matrix(0.94,0,0,0.94,0,0), after=none.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B passed cleanly on web preview. Testable flows all have testIDs: btn-pause, btn-resume, btn-retry (pause), btn-quit (pause), btn-next, btn-retry-outcome, btn-quit-outcome, btn-watch-ad (only when areAdsReady()), btn-left, btn-right, btn-jump, hud-timer. Double-tap guard is 450 ms. Hint auto-fades after 4.5 s + 600 ms. WATCH AD is intentionally not shown on web preview (ads only init on Android with consent).
